$$

which of the following could be the definition of $f(x,y)?$

solution:

![](images/66/66f4c5d8824bf692d096ed533d90c9fdcf80c3725828e9033308757a0cdaa779.png)

Notice that the rectangle $R$ contains the region $D$ completely. 

Now, if we define $f(x,y)$ to be equal $xy+{y}^{2}$ on $D$ and to be equal $0$ outside $D,$ we obtain

$$
{∬}_{D}(xy+{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A={∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

With that in mind, let's examine each of the given functions.

- Functions ${\begin{aligned}xy+{y}^{2}, & (x,y)\in D \\ 0, & (x,y)\notin D\end{aligned}$ and ${\begin{aligned}xy+{y}^{2}, & (x,y)\in D \\ 0, & (x,y)\in R∖D\end{aligned}$ equal $xy+{y}^{2}$ on $D$ and equal $0$ outside $D.$
